baseline_cv.description: Baseline EfficientNet-B0, no augmentation. Case-level out-of-fold predictions on the CV pool; the test set was not used.

tone_analysis_cv.description: Phase 4. Baseline EfficientNet-B0 (no augmentation, 5 epochs) rerun with several seeds on the same CV folds; case-level out-of-fold predictions on the CV pool. The test set was not used.

accuracy.note: Standardised CIs are too narrow when a cell has fewer than 5 cases (the bootstrap cannot show how much such a small cell could vary); those groups are marked reliable: false.

regression.outcome: case predicted correctly (one row per case per seed)

phase5_cv.description: Phase 5. Image-processing settings compared with the baseline on the same CV cases (out-of-fold, case level, seed mean). The test set was not used.

selection.reason: no setting improves overall balanced_accuracy over the baseline outside the noise (without hurting an FST group), so the simplest setting is kept

phase5_cv.multiple_comparisons_note: 60 paired comparisons are reported. At a 95% level about 1 in 20 differences with no real effect will still look outside the noise, so a single isolated 'outside the noise' result, especially in a small group, is weak evidence.

phase6_gradcam.description: Phase 6. Grad-CAM from the final baseline model (trained on the whole CV pool) on every CV image, toward the class the seed-42 out-of-fold model predicted. Correct / incorrect = out-of-fold. The test set was not used.
phase6_gradcam.note: border_share = share of the heatmap's mass in the outer border band. If the model looked everywhere equally it would equal border_share_if_uniform; much higher would suggest it relies on borders, backgrounds or framing.

test_final.description: Phase 7. The one-time test-set evaluation of the frozen method (baseline EfficientNet-B0, ImageNet weights, no augmentation, 5 epochs, seed 42) trained on all CV cases. Case level; 95% bootstrap CIs resample cases.

cv_comparison.cv_source: seed-42 out-of-fold predictions on the CV pool (the same procedure, models trained on 4 of 5 folds)
